summary: Configured node1 as the cluster NTP source and node2 to synchronize exclusively from node1. Both nodes retained CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5, and passed sequential restart-persistence verification.
actions_performed: Backed up both original NTP configurations.
Enabled node1 to serve NTP to the internal subnet and persisted its UDP/123 firewall rule.
Removed node2's public and local time sources and configured 10.100.252.10 as its sole preferred source.
Enabled ntpd at boot on both nodes.
Restarted node2 and node1 individually, verified changed boot identities, and confirmed full NTP recovery.

evidence.requirement: Node1 operates as the internal time source
evidence.summary: Shows running/enabled ntpd, internal-subnet access, UDP/123 listener, persisted firewall allowance, and healthy upstream synchronization.

evidence.requirement: Node2 synchronizes against node1 instead of public servers
evidence.summary: Shows 10.100.252.10 as the only active source and selected system peer, with node2 synchronized at stratum 4.

evidence.requirement: Legacy operating-system release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on CentOS 5.11 with kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 and use the installed ntpd service.
